intro: Twogether is made for you. With dual mattresses, easy pull-out storage, and handy shelves, it brings comfort, convenience, and style to your space — because every detail should work for you.

features.title: Strength that stands the test of time
features.text: Built with a metal frame made of CRCA steel pipes, this diwan bed provides a sturdy and long-lasting foundation, perfect for both lounging and sleeping.

features.title: One pull, and it’s ready to go
features.text: Effortlessly switch from a cozy diwan to a comfortable bed with a smooth pull-out system powered by rollers and magnets—making every transition seamless and stress-free.

features.title: Flexibility meets comfort every moment
features.text: Comes with two premium mattresses that ensure even weight distribution, giving you both daybed comfort and nighttime support.

features.title: One pull, and it’s all there
features.text: Twin drawers beneath the mattress provide ample space to neatly store blankets, pillows, or seasonal items, keeping your room clutter-free.

features.title: Handy shelves for everyday essentials
features.text: The diwan’s headboard storage section features a durable mat membrane surface, ideal for holding books, décor, or gadgets within arm’s reach.

name: Twogether Diwan Fabric Sofa Cum Bed With Mattress
